newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilgener to increase capital - report.
newsitem.headline: Chilgener to increase capital - report.

text.p: Chilean electricity utility Chilgener is planning a $500 million capital increase to finance its expansion over the next three years, reported newspaper El Mercurio Friday.
The company said it will issue shares in Chile and abroad through the American deposity receipt (ADR) mechanism.
The newspaper, quoting the company's finance manager Laurence Golbourne, said the funds will be used for projects in Chile, Argentina, Brazil and Colombia.
The capital increase will be voted on at a shareholders' meeting on March 25.
Chilgener is Chile's second largest power generator.
